description: This file defines the JitReports class, a subclass of Jit, responsible for processing and generating XML data for chart reports within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods for calculating totals, checking currency types, processing hierarchical report data, and generating XML representations for charts.

classes.name: JitReports
classes.description: A class extending Jit, tailored for generating report data for chart visualizations in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JitReports instance by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: calculateReportGroupTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total of 'numerical_value' fields in the dataset.

methods.name: isCurrencyReportGroupTotal
methods.description: Checks whether all 'numerical_value' entries in the dataset are marked as currency.

methods.name: processReportData
methods.description: Recursively processes report datasets to generate formatted report data.

methods.name: processReportGroup
methods.description: Determines the super set of groupings from the dataset for hierarchical report structuring.

methods.name: xmlDataReportSingleValue
methods.description: Generates XML data for a report with a single value per group.

methods.name: xmlDataReportChart
methods.description: Creates XML data suitable for chart visualization, including labels and subgroup data.

methods.name: processXmlData
methods.description: Orchestrates the generation of XML report data based on the dataset and chart type.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the chart within a div, preparing the necessary XML data and invoking parent display method.
